entry.title: Resolution 609 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): FC-162: Recommended adoption - 8/4/2026
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS FOR THE FUNDING OF COST ITEMS ASSOCIATED WITH THE HAWAIʻI GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION, BARGAINING UNIT 15, FOR THE CONTRACT PERIOD BEGINNING JULY 1, 2025, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2029

The estimated costs over the four years of the new contact resulting from lump- sum payments, across-the-board increases, and step movements would be $1,819,315.

Latest action: FC-162: Recommended adoption - 8/4/2026
